reason: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:153-155, the patch defines `def include_website_name` without a trailing `?`, whereas ActiveModel::Serializer (v0.8.3) requires `include_<attr>?` predicates (as used throughout UserSerializer). Because `include_website_name?` is undefined, the method is never invoked and `:website_name` (app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:43) is always serialized, returning `nil` (JSON `null`) via `return if website_host.nil?` at app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:140 when no website is set.
